text:
Aisha K: Found credentials leaked in partner debug dump: s3://partner-temp/ingestZ/2026-04-02/debug.txt. Contains a JSON SA key with private_key field. Need rotation plan and short-term containment. @Akshay please triage.
Akshay: Copy. Short checklist: disable key, rotate Vault secret, confirm KMS wrap of replacement, enable audit logs, and quarantine file. Running `gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=redwood-ingest@project` to match id.
Dmitri: Also search Vault for any raw blobs: `vault kv list -format=json secret/partners | xargs -I{} vault kv get -format=json secret/{}` then grep for "private_key". If found, mark as compromised.
Aisha K: Quarantined object and made a snapshot. File path: s3://partner-temp/ingestZ/2026-04-02/debug.txt.gz. Blob shows private_key_id: 9f8e7d6c.
Akshay: Disabled key 9f8e7d6c at 2026-04-02T18:05:12Z and deleted. Created temporary replacement SA redwood-ingest-temp@project with minimal roles. Wrapped new JSON with KMS and wrote to secret/partners/ingestz/sa-v2.
Dmitri: Pushed a temporary Vault policy to deny reads on secret/partners/ingestz/* for CI until rotation finishes. Also requested @sre-bot to create an alert for multiple reads from unusual IPs.
sre-bot: Created alert `vault.reads.ingestz.anomaly` -> webhook to #incidents.
Akshay: Ran repo search for the old SA email `rg "redwood-ingest@project" || true` and kicked off log scan for Unwrap calls. Found one Unwrap from partner IP range at 2026-04-01T22:40:00Z; exporting to incident doc.
Aisha K: Notifying partner and CS now. Legal on standby. We'll need a postmortem; Akshay to own timeline.
Platform Team: We'll add a pre-ingest pattern check to reject uploads containing `private_key` and create an emergency ticket. Medium-term: require KMS-wrapped keys or WIF for all partner ingestion.
Akshay: I'll prepare rotation PR and the postmortem skeleton. Leaving thread open for any further anomalous auth attempts. :white_check_mark:
